Beatrice Kushan is the mother of Kila Kushan and leader of the Kushan Army.

She is one of the two villainous heroines of Prison Battleship 3.

Personality
Beatrice is an ambitious woman with plans to rule the universe with an iron fist, shows signs of being a sociopath.

She has a charismatic personality that charms her soldiers into following her, and her devious tactics are as vile as her personality, and is easily the most evil, proud, abusive and traitorous person. Beatrice is also a sadist who hates weak people, going so far as to belittle them whenever she pleases.

She is known for the war crimes she committed in the pursuit of her ambitions, leading to the deaths of countless civilians, and although she loves her husband and daughter, she would betray them easily to save her own skin. Though she is ready to die for her ambitions, she breaks down after her husband finds out about the events onboard of the Battleship Tristan.

Appearance
Beatrice is a middle-aged but young looking woman with violet eyes. The uniform she wore appeared to be a red-and-brown, with a white outer cloth and white gloves.

She has long red hair that reaches down to her thighs.

History
Background
Beatrice Kushan was a powerful figure and an admiral of the Neo Terra, known for her strategy and cruelty.

Beatrice, family and direct followes are the offspring of the exiles of a nation, which had been destroyed by thermonuclear weapons, during the unification wars on Earth in the distant past. Even now Beatrice, holds value to this and desires to restore that destroyed nation.

Kushan, secretly, was the lover of Lucius Romanoff, a high ranking Neo Terra, and had a daughter with him Kila Kushan but kept the connection to Lucius as a secret to the public. She was the commander of the Martian division of the Neo Terra Armed Forces, but she defected with multiple Neo Terrans. Forming the Kushan Army, she made sure that the destruction of the terraforming plant on Mars, leading to desertification, and equipped her army for desert combat beforehand, giving her an advantage. She furthermore destroyed 14 of the 15 space lifts, which made further supply of new resources even harder.

Her army attacked multiple city states and took over 80% of the Mars. Because of the multiple war crimes and cruelty, she became known as "The Empress". She uses battleships that are able to swim on the sand sea and Perseus City as a stronghold. Her official residential mansion lies in Cyrus, a small town in Perseus City. She used a blockade to starve 120000 people to death and assassinated entire families, which opposed her in the past and is feared because of that. Afterward, Lacerta City's "Joan of Arc of Mars" Yuria Balzer failed an assassination attempt on Beatrice and was captured. Beatrice ordered the death of Yuria's entire family including infant children, would cut of her limbs, and torture her for weeks before she finally bled out, Beatrice was watching the public display, without betting an eye.

Beatrice, is very strict on her daughter, Kila Kushan, which acts as her bodyguard. It is suggested, that the civil war, is ultimately only a ruse, for Lucius to solve diplomatically, which would give him an entry as one of the four elders of the Neo Terra, and use his power to rebuild the original country of the Kushan and Romanoff.
